text:
First, convert 17 weeks and 4 days to days:  
17 weeks = 17 × 7 = 119 days  
Add 4 days → 123 days total to subtract.

03-15-1722 minus 123 days:  
March has 31 days, so going back:  
March 15 − 15 days = March 1.  
Remaining days: 123 − 15 = 108 days earlier.

February 1722 had 28 days (not leap year, since 1722 not divisible by 4).  
From March 1 back 28 days = February 1.  
Remaining: 108 − 28 = 80 days earlier.

January 1722 has 31 days: from Feb 1 back 31 days = January 1.  
Remaining: 80 − 31 = 49 days earlier.

December 1721 has 31 days: from Jan 1 back 31 days = December 1, 1721.  
Remaining: 49 − 31 = 18 days earlier.

November 1721 has 30 days: from Dec 1 back 18 days = November 13, 1721.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1721-11-13
